propositions: Four model-provenance test guards each independently call _run_request_sites(), re-deriving the same immutable AST analysis of the src/rebar tree, causing redundant whole-tree scans across test cases.

Within each _run_request_sites() call, the _verdict() function re-walks and re-parses the entire src/rebar source tree once per parameter-provenance site, causing thousands of redundant parses in a single scan.
_run_request_sites() analysis is a pure function of committed src/rebar source that no test mutates and no test-time patches affect, making it safe to cache per process.
Session-scoped fixture caching of _run_request_sites() plus per-path parse memoization remove both layers of repetition while preserving all assertion semantics, message content, and registry checks.
